channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: Dishware
item.description: Adds ceramic dishes such as plates and cups.

item.title: Project Globe
item.description: A silly little mod that gives the world wrap around/globe logic.

item.title: Gentage
item.description: Heritable genetics for vanilla animals: traits improve or worsen each generation

item.title: Fauna of the Stone Age: Vanilla Values
item.description: An optional add-on mod that changes Fauna of the Stone Age animal drops to Vanilla Values

item.title: Floating Text Images and Gifs
item.description: Adds Floating text to your game.

item.title: Smart TV
item.description: This mod adds a flat screen wall mounted tv that is resizable. Only available in the creative menu

item.title: Better Fruit Press
item.description: Makes the fruit press quicker and allows squeezing over barrels.

item.title: Wilderlands Caves
item.description: Fundamentally overhauls cave generation, while keeping vanilla caves at configurable rates.

item.title: Aegis - Client
item.description: Early client support for an upcoming Vintage Story multiplayer games network.

item.title: Additional Hair Colors
item.description: Gives the player a lot more options for hair colors, should work with modded races.

item.title: Packrat + MoreInventorys Compat
item.description: Makes MoreInventorys storage contents show up in Packrat's hotkey window, quick stacking items too.

item.title: QP's Chisel Tools
item.description: Unleash your creativity while chiseling! Invaluable, survival friendly tool set for chiselers!

item.title: Animalica Requests
item.description: Adds deer antlers for foxes and hares, plus a tailless fox option.

item.title: Outlier Network Core
item.description: Wayfinder, jobs, homes, plots and cosmetic menus for players on Outlier Network.

item.title: Draconis_Dracaris
item.description: Adds a fire breath mechanic to draconis dragons, targeted for our ever yander server

item.title: No Forced Village Climate
item.description: This structure now always follows the surrounding climate..

item.title: VS Roofing Mod
item.description: Gridless roof building system with vanilla style roofs, glass houses and more!

item.title: 套索 VSCN Roping
item.description: Throwable lassos, binding and tethering for players and creatures.

item.title: XRB
item.description: XRB is a JEI-style item and recipe browser for Vintage Story.

item.title: Plant-based Fat
item.description: Fat alternative for peaceful progress

item.title: ExtendedHUDInfoREBUILT
item.description: HUD Info that displays QOL details without a background

item.title: Pulse
item.description: Your server's vital signs on a Prometheus endpoint. Grafana-ready, panel-friendly, OTLP optional.

item.title: Vintage Przygoda: Korony
item.description: Mod serwera Vintage Przygoda: Korony. Potrzebny tylko do gry na tym serwerze.

item.title: Rudiments
item.description: Pre-industrial craft, done properly. Fibre, clay, kilns— one step at a time.

item.title: Chaos Mod
item.description: #1 Mod to crash your game.

item.title: Inventory Jump+Run Fix
item.description: Allows you to jump and sprint while the inventory is open.

item.title: Linked Inventories
item.description: Automatically opens and neatly positions the player inventory together with supported containers.

item.title: Particles Plus
item.description: Particles for resin, high fertility, pretta soils, meteoric iron. Fully customizable, add your own.

item.title: Plant Fiber Hide
item.description: A plant based alternative for animal hides

item.title: ChunkReloader
item.description: Reloads worlds chunks and restores them to the state of seed generation.
